details.description: Accepted Agent sidebar Client before the preset contact visibility release.

change_summary.expected_result: Exactly seven system-managed preset Workflow Agents omit the entire contact row on market cards, Agent detail, and new-conversation welcome. Contact rendering for personal Agents and every Agent outside the exact stable-ID list remains unchanged.
functions: Deploy the verified preset-agent-contact-visibility Client artifact
Return null from the shared AgentContact component for exactly seven stable preset Agent IDs
Preserve support contact, owner fallback, plain-name, and no-contact rendering for all other Agents
Preserve the accepted Agent market, sidebar, category, starter, model, tool, ACL, file, Skill, upload, generated-file, usage, login, search, and context-safety behavior
Capture the exact active Client mount and protected service identities before replacing only /app/client/dist:ro
Recreate only LibreChat-API and automatically restore the previous Client mount on deployment failure
limitations: The stable-ID list is intentionally exact; future preset Agent IDs require a reviewed source change
No Agent or user document is changed and the prior data-only contact-removal release remains rolled back
No billable model request is required or allowed
The binary Client ZIP is immutable and verified but is not committed to Git
change_summary.reason: Remove the non-actionable Contact: LibreChat Workflow Agent line from the seven preset Agents without activating LibreChat's owner-contact fallback and without weakening contact support for user-created Agents.
change_summary.risk: A broad Client change could hide contact information from personal Agents, lose protected overlays, serve stale assets, or recreate unrelated services. The release locks the upstream archive, three source patches, seven exact IDs, successful CI run, independently reproduced ZIP, protected assets, active mount, service identities, and API-only Compose target.

details.command: Run the versioned remote-rollback.sh with the timestamp-matched backup directory and runtime-preflight.json.
details.restore_scope: Restore the exact pre-release compose.override.yaml and active /app/client/dist mount, then recreate only LibreChat-API.
details.unchanged_data: Agents, users, ACLs, categories, files, Skills, conversations, models, MongoDB, CodeAPI, RAG, Admin Panel, NGINX, Office Converter, and Runtime Connector are outside the write scope.
